name: 2023 DWR Delivery Capability Report scenario with historically adjusted hydroclimate and TUCPs
simple_description: Baseline scenario with TUCPs active
description: Baseline scenario based on DWR's 2023 Delivery Capability Report using historically adjusted hydroclimate. TUCP actions are active. The code and input hydrology were taken from DWR's 2023 DCR final version, representing current operating rules including the 2019 Biological Opinion and 2020 SWP Incidental Take Permit. The only difference from s0002 is that TUCP actions are allowed.

name: 2023 DWR Delivery Capability Report scenario with historically adjusted hydroclimate and updated agricultural land use demands and TUCPs
simple_description: Baseline with 2020 LandIQ land use and TUCPs
description: Baseline scenario based on DWR's 2023 DCR with historically adjusted hydroclimate and 2020 LandIQ agricultural land use. TUCP actions active. Builds on s0011 — the only difference is updated agricultural land use derived from the 2020 LandIQ dataset. Serves as the primary reference for most alternative scenarios.

name: 2023 DWR Delivery Capability Report scenario with historically adjusted hydroclimate and updated agricultural land use demands, without TUCPs
simple_description: Baseline with 2020 LandIQ land use without TUCPs
description: Same as s0020 except TUCP actions are deactivated (simulateTUCP set to 0). Serves as a baseline reference for scenarios without TUCP actions.

name: USBR's 2024 LTO proposed action (Alt2V1) with DWR's adjusted historical hydrology, 2020 LandIQ land use, and 2024 USBR BiOps. No TUCPs.
simple_description: USBR 2024 proposed operations without TUCPs
description: Operating rules and policies from USBR's 2024 final LTO scenario Alt2V1, reflecting USBR's proposed action from the December 2024 LTO consultation. Original USBR hydrology replaced with DWR's historically adjusted dataset and 2020 LandIQ land use applied. TUCP actions not active. Includes modified Shasta storage and CVP allocation rules benefiting winter-run chinook salmon.

name: USBR's 2024 LTO proposed action (Alt2V1) with DWR's adjusted historical hydrology, 2020 LandIQ land use, 2024 USBR BiOps, and TUCPs active.
simple_description: USBR 2024 proposed operations with TUCPs
description: Same as s0023 with TUCP actions activated. Copied from s0023 with TUCP trigger conditions uncommented in TUCP_Actions.wresl. TUCP actions can be triggered in February through May when Sacramento Valley index and Shasta storage fall below thresholds.

name: s0020 baseline with SGMA-type groundwater pumping limits applied to San Joaquin Valley region.
simple_description: San Joaquin Valley groundwater pumping limits
description: Assigns groundwater pumping limits to demand units in the San Joaquin Valley. Limits are set to minimize groundwater storage decline over 100 years. Derived from s0020 — only difference is modification of groundwater pumping limits for SJV demand units.

name: s0020 baseline with SGMA-type groundwater pumping limits applied across entire Central Valley.
simple_description: Central Valley-wide groundwater pumping limits
description: Assigns groundwater pumping limits to demand units across the entire Central Valley CalSim3 domain. Limits set to minimize groundwater storage decline over 100 years. Derived from s0020 — only difference is modification of groundwater pumping limits for all Central Valley demand units.

name: Functional flows scenario with requirements on tributaries and Delta. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Functional flows on tributaries and Delta
description: Sets new minimum flow requirements on Sacramento and San Joaquin tributaries plus Delta outflow. Flow requirements developed by COEQWAL eflows team. Implements functional flow requirements at 17 locations as minimums (not strict controls). Derived from s0011 with 2020 LandIQ land use update. Deactivated — superseded by later scenarios.

name: Reduced agricultural acreage in the San Joaquin Valley to improve groundwater sustainability under SGMA.
simple_description: Reduced ag acreage to improve GW in the San Joaquin
description: Reduced irrigated agricultural acreage in San Joaquin Valley WBAs to achieve balanced groundwater conditions. Uses 2020 LandIQ land use as basis with modifications to ag land use for select WBAs to mitigate groundwater decline. Derived from s0020.

name: Reduced agricultural acreage across the Central Valley to improve groundwater sustainability under SGMA.
simple_description: Reduced ag acreage to improve GW in the Central Valley
description: Reduced irrigated agricultural acreage across the entire Central Valley to achieve balanced groundwater conditions. Uses 2020 LandIQ land use with modified ag acreage for WBAs and DUs therein. Derived from s0020.

name: Existing flow requirements on Central Valley tributaries removed. Delta outflow requirements maintained. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Remove minimum flow requirements in Central Valley
description: Removes minimum flow requirements on rivers and streams throughout the Central Valley and rim watersheds. Delta outflow requirements remain per D1641 and Biological Opinions. Created as an exploratory reference point against which functional flows and standard scenarios can be compared. Derived from s0029 by setting flow requirement switches to 0.

name: Salmon-friendly flow requirements and Shasta storage protection. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Salmon-friendly flows and Shasta storage protection
description: Modified functional flow requirements adjusted for Winter-run Chinook salmon survival on the Sacramento River, combined with Shasta cold water pool protection. Derived from s0029.

name: Functional flow requirements at 17 locations combined with Central Valley groundwater pumping limits. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Functional flows with reduced CV-wide ag acreage
description: Combines functional flow requirements of s0029 with reduced irrigated acreage of s0028. Intended to offset high water demands of functional flows with lower demand to mitigate extreme reservoir drawdown.

name: Salmon-friendly flow requirements combined with Central Valley groundwater pumping limits. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Salmon-friendly flows with reduced CV-wide ag acreage
description: Combines salmon-friendly flow requirements of s0031 with reduced irrigated acreage of s0028. Intended to offset high water demands of salmon flows with lower demand to mitigate extreme reservoir drawdown.

name: USBR Alternative 3 with allocation reductions and 65% unimpaired Delta outflow. Modified BiOps, limits on exports.
simple_description: USBR alt3 - allocation reductions and 65% unimpaired Delta outflow
description: Adapted from USBR's Alt3 exploratory scenario (2024 LTO). Replaces USBR hydrology with DWR historically adjusted hydrology; updates to 2020 LandIQ land use. Applies 65% unimpaired flow requirement for the Delta (December–May). CVP Settlement allocations may be reduced to 0%.

name: USBR Alternative 3 with allocation reductions and 35% unimpaired Delta outflow. Modified BiOps, limits on exports.
simple_description: USBR alt3 - allocation reductions and 35% unimpaired Delta outflow
description: Adapted from USBR's Alt3 exploratory scenario (2024 LTO). Same as s0039 but with Delta outflow requirement reduced from 65% to 35% unimpaired flow (December–May).

name: USBR Alternative 3 with allocation reductions and 45% unimpaired Delta outflow. Modified BiOps, limits on exports.
simple_description: USBR alt3 - allocation reductions and 45% unimpaired Delta outflow
description: Adapted from USBR's Alt3 and s0039. Same configuration with Delta outflow requirement reduced to 45% unimpaired flow (December–May).

name: USBR Alternative 3 with allocation reductions and 55% unimpaired Delta outflow. Modified BiOps, limits on exports.
simple_description: USBR alt3 - allocation reductions and 55% unimpaired Delta outflow
description: Adapted from USBR's Alt3 and s0039. Same configuration with Delta outflow requirement at 55% unimpaired flow (December–May).

name: Increase Shasta Reservoir carryover storage target by 20%. CVP Settlement Contractor allocations reduced as needed. Modified BiOps.
simple_description: Increase Shasta carryover target by 20% compared to s0020
description: CVP Settlement Contractor allocations reduced in spring to increase Shasta carryover storage target by 20% relative to s0020 baseline. Because CalSim sets allocations under uncertainty, the carryover condition is not guaranteed but should increase Shasta storage in many years.

name: Remove fall X2 salinity standard in the Delta. Modified BiOps. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Remove fall X2 salinity requirement in the Delta
description: Removes the requirement for X2 conditions to be met in August–October ('fall X2') as originally set by 2008-2009 biological opinions. Other Delta flow and salinity requirements remain in place. Derived from s0020.

name: Remove Delta and lower Sacramento/San Joaquin River flow requirements. 2020 LandIQ land use.
simple_description: Remove Delta and lower Sac/SJR flow requirements
description: Removes Delta outflow and lower Sacramento/San Joaquin River flow requirements. Derived from s0020 with 2020 LandIQ land use.

name: DWR 2025 climate adaptation Delta Conveyance Project scenario. 2020 LandIQ land use, voluntary agreements.
simple_description: DWR 2025 DCP scenario with 2020 land use and voluntary agreements
description: DWR 2025 climate adaptation scenario including the Delta Conveyance Project with 2020 LandIQ land use and voluntary water agreements.
